scope: Hormuz diplomacy / peace progress; source-publication dates (UTC), not live probabilities

signals.title: US president says a peace deal with Iran is unnecessary, weakening near-term deal expectations
signals.limitation: A stated US position, not proof that every mediation channel has permanently ended or that future talks are impossible.

signals.title: Four tanker explosions claimed by Iran; a separately reported UKMTO strike underscores continued shipping risk
signals.limitation: Reuters could not independently verify all Iranian tanker claims; do not equate an attack report with confirmed barrels disrupted.

signals.title: Iran's security chief says no active US talks and conditions remain unmet
signals.limitation: An attributed Iranian position, not proof that every mediation channel has stopped.

signals.title: Iran warns it could target US bases beyond the Gulf if used in attacks
signals.limitation: A conditional threat, not independent proof of strikes on European bases.

signals.title: US president holds off additional strikes as Qatar remains involved
signals.limitation: Reduced immediate escalation risk does not mean a deal, lifting of blockade or safe shipping.
